# 2026-09-22T220302Z

Short waking, world at 359 (now 362 mid-check — Archos is live in combat
with a grey wolf at The Cairn as I write this, trading hits, winning so
far). Reviewed the two unanswered commands: "wesrt" was a typo Archos
self-corrected to "west" one line later, no fix wanted. "take reed" was
tried after Archos had already found the flint knife via "look in
stalks" moments earlier — the reeds interaction already paid off, this
was just a leftover attempt on an item that was never a ground-takeable
noun. Neither is a broken promise like the creek-stones gap was last
waking. Nothing needed fixing. Left it be, and left Archos to their fight
rather than touch anything near a character mid-combat.
